wins: Established baseline reconnaissance and identified open service fingerprints quickly via automated nmap scans.
Maintained consistent engagement in each mentor call, resulting in the full 10-feedback loop capturing actionable guidance.
fails: Failed to leverage discovered footholds to escalate privileges—the run ended with no successful post-exploitation actions.
No persistence or lateral movement techniques were executed despite identifying initial access vector.
key_outcomes.summary: The run demonstrates solid reconnaissance discipline but stalls after initial discovery, leaving privilege escalation and persistence untouched.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance completed but no follow-up exploitation script or custom payload launch

skill_cards.if_condition: When open SSH port detected during initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration scripts and capture banner details

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration reveals default credentials or weak password hints
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt SSH login starting with identified inherited credentials using Hydra

skill_cards.if_condition: When Windows host discovered post-authentication with service misconfigurations
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy Metasploit local exploit module (e.g., ms17_010) to elevate privileges

memory_ops.reason: Reliable identification of SSH characteristics sets stage for follow-up access attempts

next_experiments.title: Automated exploitation attempt after SSH enumeration
next_experiments.description: After confirming SSH reachability, execute a scripted Hydra brute-force chain targeting identified usernames and rotate payloads based on success to transition into post-exploitation.

next_experiments.title: Post-auth persistence verification
next_experiments.description: Once SSH access confirmed, immediately deploy persistence modules (e.g., cron job, Scheduled Task) to validate ability to maintain foothold.

next_experiments.title: Privilege escalation enumeration
next_experiments.description: Run local vulnerability checks on the compromised host (LinPEAS/WinPEAS) to identify misconfigurations before attempting exploit modules, documenting findings step-by-step.
